item.title: Playhead 0.1.0 (build 5)
item.description:
What's new

  • Playhead for Windows. Playhead now runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and 11 as well as macOS; the Windows download is on the Playhead page.
  • On the Mac, this is the first update delivered automatically. Nothing else changed.

Installing on Windows

  • Run Playhead-windows-setup.exe. It installs for your user only, with no administrator prompt.
  • The installer isn't code-signed yet, so the first time SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC": click More info → Run anyway.
  • After that it keeps itself up to date, like the Mac version.
